senses.en_definition: To change; to become different from an original or previous state.
To vary or fluctuate over time.
To become different in colour, appearance, or expression.
To turn into something else or pass into a different state.
(Perak dialect) To move to another place or position, or change direction.

messages.en: Our plans have changed. It's raining too hard, so we're not going to the park after all.
So where shall we meet, then? I'm all ready.
Let's just meet at the café near your place. Still three o'clock, like we said earlier. Is that okay?

collocations.en: more than a hundred years old

messages.en: My child is five now. Can I sign them up for this class?
Yes, you can, ma'am. Please fill in this form first.

senses.en_definition: To move backwards or step back.
To leave or withdraw from a situation, or step down from a position.
To retreat in battle when unable to continue resisting the enemy.

messages.en: I'm at the waterfall now. Going to take some photos on this big rock.
Don't back up all the way to the edge of that rock. It's slippery back there. I nearly slipped there earlier.
Oh, okay. I'll just take photos down below, then.

collocations.en: be lucky enough to get an opportunity

messages.en: Wow, you're so lucky! I tried to buy one earlier, but they were already sold out.
